title: Strictly No Elephants
author: Lisa Mantchev

hero.source_note: Generic elephant symbol from Boardmaker should work well for this character

ambiguous.reason: The book's central theme is belonging and being included; 'belong' is more book-specific and avoids duplication with core. Swap 'different' for 'belong' in fringe.

notes: The book's core themes are inclusion, belonging, and friendship — a pet elephant is excluded from Pet Club because he is different, then the boy and his elephant start their own inclusive club. Key vocabulary should reflect these social-emotional themes. 'Different' appears in fixed core row 2 so 'belong' is recommended as a replacement fringe word. The existing activity_images already include 'elephant' which can serve double duty as the hero image. Secondary animal characters (penguin, skunk, bat, whale) are already in activity_images and may be used as supporting fringe if the board is expanded. The 11 chosen words prioritise the book's social narrative over character names.
